adapters.name: Workspace VFS
adapters.note: Workspace-contained virtual filesystem; arbitrary host filesystem access is intentionally unavailable.

adapters.name: Native ESM publication + CommonJS loader
adapters.note: Selected Node 24 resolution semantics are implemented; native addons and some dynamic loader behavior remain unsupported.

adapters.name: ProcessSupervisor
adapters.note: Virtual commands/process receipts replace arbitrary host process creation; child_process execution is unavailable.

adapters.name: PreviewAuthority virtual HTTP
adapters.note: Preview routes are virtual browser-facing routes; raw host TCP listeners are not exposed to guest code.

adapters.name: Frozen npm installer
adapters.note: package-lock v2/v3 + SRI are supported; pnpm/yarn lockfiles and lifecycle script execution are not in the promoted profile.

adapters.name: VFS/HMR generation path
adapters.note: Vite HMR is promoted; generic Node filesystem watcher parity is not.

adapters.name: Browser tty adapter
adapters.note: WriteStream.hasColors() returns false and terminal dimensions/capabilities are conservative in the browser profile.

adapters.name: Native addon boundary
adapters.note: Native .node binaries and node-gyp execution are outside the browser runtime boundary.

adapters.name: Capability-authorized fetch
adapters.note: External http(s) is capability-mediated; raw TCP/UDP is unavailable to guest code.
